name: mockup
title: Mockup of the real screen
summary: A realistic screen of what the video talks about (a console, an app, a page, a terminal, an inbox, a phone, a document) made of typed sections.
useWhen: The video talks about something the viewer will meet on a real screen: an alert, a dashboard, a form, a log, an email, a command. Show what it will look like.
scene: Under the video, when the video is about a tool, a console or a document the viewer will use for real: show that screen, and let each chapter point at the alert, row, place or button the narrator is talking about.
